newsitem.title: CHILE: Lan Chile to fly to Falkland Islands.
newsitem.headline: Lan Chile to fly to Falkland Islands.

text.p: Chile's largest airline Lan Chile said Monday it will start weekly flights from the southern city of Punta Arenas to the Falkland Islands.
The service was due to start July 26, but has been delayed because of problems with flight permits, said a spokeswoman for the airline.
The decision comes three months after another local carrier, Dap, suspended flights to Port Stanley, leaving the islands without any direct airlink to the Latin American mainland.

The flights will take advantage of the growing tourist trade in the islands and the development of the Falklands' off-shore oil fields, said Hugh Normand, general manager of the Falkland Islands Development Corporation.
"The flights will allow us to import fruit and vegetables and other products, make the transfer of business passengers easier and allow tourist development," said Normand in a statement.
The Falklands have had no air or trade links with nearest neighbor Argentina since the 1982 war with Britain over the islands, known in Spanish as Islas Malvinas.
